Military vehicle maintenance facility cl.basis: Warehouse post-construction cleaning plus trench drain and separator inlet detailing, +10% for base access

Government hospital and VA medical facil.basis: Healthcare post-construction terminal-style clean ($0.40/0.70/1.20, 60 sf/hr) +10% for ICRA protocols, facility access and documentation
